Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest

Class BBScenarios

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.gametest.BBScenarios
final class BBScenarios extends Object
Big Bucket world, cauldron, cow, and milk scenarios shared by every loader. Player scenarios stand a player above TARGET looking down and right-click through GameTestSupport.useItem(net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player, net.minecraft.world.InteractionHand) or SharedGameTestSupport.clickBlock(net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player, net.minecraft.world.InteractionHand, net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult).
